newsitem.title: FRANCE: France sees 0.1 pct drop in 97 sunflower sowings.
newsitem.headline: France sees 0.1 pct drop in 97 sunflower sowings.

text.p: France's farm ministry said on Wednesday that sunflower sowings for the 1997 harvest may drop by 0.1 percent to 890,000 hectares from 891,000 hectares in 1996.
In its first estimate for the 1997 sunflower crop dated May 1 the ministry said that 55 percent of the total area had been sown to sunflower so far this season.
The ministry also predicted the area sown to soybean may rise by 7.9 percent to 93,000 hectares.
It revised its estimate for the rapeseed area upwards to 950,000 hectares from 947,000 hectares forecast last month. This would represent a rise of 8.6 percent over 1996.
It put total sowings for oilseeds at 1.933 million hectares, up 4.4 percent over 1996.
